paragraphs: IC Bus builds buses, and says it has been moving students to and from school for more than 90 years. The lineup is organized in series, among them the CE Series school bus. Commercial versions are sold as well, such as the RE Series commercial bus.

Buyers can choose an internal combustion engine. Zero emissions options are presented as a line of solutions of their own. The blog is pitched at districts that want electric buses but do not know where to start. A team at the company helps school districts work through the bus funding process. Dealer and service support sits alongside the vehicles, and extended service contracts are offered.

The company traces its start to a small operation in Arkansas. Its Tulsa bus plant has turned out 250,000 units over 25 years of operation. The company writes about the people who build each CE Series and take that responsibility personally.

quote.text: For over 90 years, IC Bus has been moving students safely to and from school.
